doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: Happy Anniversary Charlie Brown and Joe Williams
summary: Gluck says he mixed B.B. King and Patti Austin tracks but not Joe Williams' on that record.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: I love those kind of stories. You did — actually there’s a name on your list of a fellow who is very important to our project here, Joe Williams. And he was on that “Happy Anniversary Charlie Brown” record.
Yes. That was recorded in many different places and I didn’t work on Joe with his track.
I did B.B. King I think and Patti Austin and then I mixed some other things that came in. I’d have to literally look at the credits to figure it out. But I don’t — no I didn’t do Joe’s thing.
